decisions.reason: The two unambiguous phrases directly capture GNN work in drug discovery without restricting it to a particular application, and the explicit years are valid.

The phrases are unambiguous and jointly cover machine-learning applications across climate-change research without imposing an application-specific restriction.
The combination is topically direct and broad enough to cover varied climate-change risks while remaining more specific than a generic climate-change query.
The two phrases clearly identify digital-twin applications in healthcare without an undue subfield constraint; the explicit 2012–2023 protocol window is valid.
The phrases jointly and unambiguously represent plant responses under both heat and drought stress, and the explicit year range is valid.
